Hiking Habits-8

This instrument is composed of eight statements about hiking. Please indicate the degree to which each statement applies to you by marking whether you:

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. I hike every weekend.

_____2. I plan hikes a month ahead.

_____3. I carry a paper map.

_____4. I check the forecast before I leave.

_____5. I hike alone.

_____6. I prefer long trails.

_____7. I take photographs on the trail.

_____8. I keep a hiking diary.

Scoring:  To compute your scores, add your scores for each item as indicated below:

Add questions 1-4 for your basic Planning Score		________

Add questions 5-8 for your basic Enjoyment Score		________

Add the two subscales together to get your Overall Hiking Score	________
